headline: GOLD MINERS LOG NEAR-RECORD $2,787/OZ PROFITS IN Q2 — 50% ABOVE YEAR-AGO, SECOND-BEST QUARTER IN HISTORY
snippet: Adam Hamilton's analysis published July 11 confirms that Q2 2026 is shaping up as the second-best earnings quarter in gold mining history: with the GDX top-25 averaging approximately $1,725/oz in all-in sustaining costs and the Q2 2026 average gold price running at $4,512/oz, implied unit profits of $2,787 per ounce represent a 50% year-over-year increase versus Q2 2025's $1,861/oz — second only to Q1 2026's $3,129/oz peak when January's $5,589 spike inflated the quarterly average. Hamilton's core thesis is that gold mining equities remain materially undervalued against this earnings power: sector P/E ratios reflect investor skepticism built during the long gold bear market, not the current reality of cash-generative operations printing $2,787/oz quarter after quarter. The important signal for junior mining investors is structural, not tactical: the major producers whose cash flows fund the streaming, royalty, and offtake deals that finance junior development are generating the widest margins in mining history. Q2 2026 financial results reporting begins in late July; each major release will test whether analyst price targets — which NEM trades roughly 44% below — are achievable from current gold prices, or whether the equity discount persists because Western institutional capital has not yet rotated back into hard assets after the January correction.

headline: GOLD $4,134 / SILVER $60.43 RALLY FRIDAY AS FED REVEALED SPLIT 9-TO-8 ON RATE HIKES — JUNE CPI JULY 14 IS THE BINARY PIVOT
snippet: Gold recovered to $4,134 and silver to $60.43 on Friday July 11, bouncing from Wednesday's lows of $4,076 and $58.80 after the June FOMC minutes revealed a committee split 9-to-8 on rate hikes — meaning only a single-vote shift would swing the committee to a rate-cut posture. September rate-hike probability on CME FedWatch slid from 63% to approximately 53% through the week, with the dollar easing and real yields pulling back from recent highs. The Cleveland Fed's inflation nowcast adds the most actionable context: its model is projecting negative month-over-month CPI readings for both June and July, driven by WTI crude's slide toward $68/barrel removing the energy-component inflationary pressure that had kept the Fed hawkish. June CPI prints Monday July 14 at 8:30 a.m. ET, with Fed Chair Warsh testifying 90 minutes later — the two events are sequenced to either confirm or refute the dovish scenario. A sub-3.8% year-over-year reading collapses September hike odds, breaks the dollar's technical support, and clears the primary macro headwind that has capped gold below $4,300 since the correction from January's peak. A 4.0%+ reading extends the correction and keeps July a holding pattern. The July 14 CPI is not incremental data — it is the single binary event that determines whether gold finishes July at $4,000 or tests $4,500.

headline: PBOC GOLD BUYING STREAK HITS 20 CONSECUTIVE MONTHS — CHINA ADDS 14.93 TONNES IN JUNE, BIGGEST MONTHLY PURCHASE SINCE 2023
snippet: The People's Bank of China added 14.93 tonnes to its gold reserves in June 2026 — a 50% jump month-on-month, the largest single-month increase in the current buying cycle since October 2023, and the 20th consecutive monthly addition extending a streak that began in November 2024. China's total gold holdings now stand at 75.44 million troy ounces (2,346 tonnes), still under 10% of total foreign exchange reserves — leaving substantial room for continued accumulation toward the 15–20% reserve ratios common among European central banks. The strategic architecture is consistent: the PBOC bought aggressively through gold's worst quarterly decline in thirteen years, meaning China's central bank deployed capital counter-cyclically to Western institutional outflows during the January–June correction. For junior mining investors, the 20-month streak establishes a sovereign-level structural demand floor beneath gold that did not exist during the 2022–2023 correction — central bank buying of this consistency and scale does not reverse on a single data print. The Hong Kong HAU gold clearing system launched last week and this sustained PBOC accumulation are two sides of the same strategic posture: China is simultaneously building the buying infrastructure and the reserve weight to anchor gold at structurally higher price levels regardless of near-term Western institutional sentiment.

headline: SITKA GOLD FILES NI 43-101: 1.29 Moz INDICATED + 3.83 Moz INFERRED AT YUKON RC GOLD PROJECT, 60,000m 2026 DRILL PROGRAM ACTIVE (TSXV:SIG)
snippet: Sitka Gold Corp. (TSXV: SIG) filed the NI 43-101 technical report for its expanded mineral resource estimate at the RC Gold Project in Yukon Territory on July 10, 2026. The report documents an indicated resource of 1,291,000 ounces of gold (39.96 Mt at 1.01 g/t) and an inferred resource of 3,829,000 ounces across three deposits — Blackjack, Eiger, and Rhosgobel — with Rhosgobel contributing a maiden 2.25 million ounce inferred resource at 0.70 g/t gold from surface that was not in any prior resource model. All three deposits are open-pit-constrained, road-accessible from Dawson City, and surface-exposed — structural characteristics that reduce infrastructure capital requirements and improve project economics in a rising gold price environment. Four diamond drill rigs are now operating as part of a 60,000-metre 2026 program targeting expansion of all three known deposits plus newly identified high-priority targets in the same corridor. At $4,100+ gold, 5.1 million aggregate ounces of NI 43-101 compliant resource in a stable Tier 1 jurisdiction with road access is the fundamental underpinning for a pre-feasibility study financing conversation; the technical report filing formalises the resource base for that discussion and establishes the baseline against which 2026 drill results will define the growth delta.

headline: WEST POINT GOLD DRILLS 56.4m @ 4.24 g/t Au AT GOLD CHAIN ARIZONA — HIGH-GRADE NE TYRO ZONE WIDENING AT DEPTH, MAIDEN RESOURCE DUE 2026 (TSXV:WPG)
snippet: West Point Gold Corp. (TSXV: WPG, OTCQB: WPGCF) reported July 9 that drill hole GC26-168 at the Northeast Tyro zone of the Gold Chain Project in Arizona intersected 56.4 metres grading 4.24 g/t gold — including 28.9 metres at 7.77 g/t from 242.3 metres depth. Companion core hole GC26-161 returned 68.2 metres at 2.20 g/t gold including 34.3 metres at 3.57 g/t gold from 210.5 metres. The geological read is important: the NE Tyro zone appears to be widening at depth — both width and grade in the July 9 holes exceed what the block model predicted for those inferred blocks — suggesting the system has better plunge continuity than early-program drilling indicated. West Point has 19 holes totalling 5,920 metres pending assay from the recently completed 21,079-metre 2026 program; all results will feed a maiden resource estimate expected later this year. Gold Chain sits on Nevada's Walker Lane, one of the most consistently productive gold corridors in North America, and at 4.24 g/t average over 56.4 metres, the NE Tyro result is the kind of high-grade core that anchors a technically credible maiden resource with favourable open-pit or underground optionality depending on depth geometry.

headline: NEXGOLD EXPANDS GOLDBORO RC INFILL TO 40,000m — 12.06 g/t Au OVER 6m CONFIRMS GRADE; UPDATED FEASIBILITY STUDY DUE Q3 2026 (TSXV:NEXG)
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. (TSXV: NEXG, OTCQX: NXGCF) reported July 9 that its reverse circulation infill program at Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia continues to deliver confidence-building results: RC-26-147 returned 6 metres at 12.06 g/t gold (including 1 metre at 67.41 g/t), RC-26-144 hit 7 metres at 9.31 g/t gold, and RC-26-102 returned 18 metres at 3.84 g/t gold — all from near-surface depths between 11 and 47 metres. Based on program results to date, NexGold expanded the RC infill from 30,000 metres to 40,000 metres, with the program now approximately 62% complete. The data feeds directly into the updated Feasibility Study due Q3 2026 — tighter near-surface resource confidence at 12 g/t grade intervals produces a fundamentally different economics package than prior feasibility iterations based on older drilling. The practical case for investors: a Nova Scotia gold project with an active updated FS timeline, 62% of a 40,000-metre confidence-building program complete, and high-grade near-surface assays confirming the resource's core grade assumptions is the pre-FS-completion setup that historically precedes the most significant re-rating in Canadian gold development companies.

headline: ARRAS MINERALS DOUBLES KAZAKHSTAN DRILL TO 40,000m AFTER $25M RAISE — COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY ADVANCING ON 4 RIGS AT ELEMES (TSXV:ARK)
snippet: Arras Minerals Corp. (TSXV: ARK) announced July 9 that following the closing of a $25 million bought deal financing at $1.36 per share on July 7, the company is doubling its 2026 diamond drilling program from 20,000 metres to 40,000 metres, targeting completion by year-end. Four drill rigs are operating on the Berezski Trend at the Elemes copper-gold porphyry project in northeastern Kazakhstan, where more than 30,000 metres have already been drilled along the trend since the 2025 discovery identified porphyry-style copper-gold mineralisation across a 10-kilometre strike length. For scale context: 10 kilometres of porphyry strike is district-scale — comparable to the initial footprint of several Tier 1 copper-gold deposits in the Western Andes before resource definition began. At $6.08/lb copper with a structural 520,000-tonne 2026 deficit, a discovery of this scope in a historically copper-endowed geological terrane advancing to 40,000 metres of drilling with institutional financing in place is among the higher-leverage copper exploration bets currently active on the TSXV — provided investors underwrite Central Asian jurisdiction risk. The expanded program will test both the depth continuity of known mineralisation and new geophysical targets identified from the 2026 survey campaign.

headline: COPPER SLIDES TO $6.08/LB AS TRUMP SCRAPS IRAN PEACE MOU — MIDDLE EAST RE-ESCALATION REVIVES DEMAND FEARS, DOLLAR SPIKES
snippet: Copper retreated sharply this week as U.S. President Trump declared the memorandum of understanding with Iran "over" following an exchange of mutual attacks, re-escalating Middle East hostilities that had temporarily appeared to be moving toward a durable ceasefire. COMEX copper fell 2.4% to $6.08/lb while LME three-month copper dropped 1.4% to $13,184/tonne. The market mechanism is two-layered: a stronger dollar (rising crude → inflation fears → Fed hawkishness → USD strength) mechanically pressures dollar-denominated metals; and the Iran conflict's disruption of sulphuric acid supply — a critical input for copper refining in the region — threatens to worsen if hostilities resume at scale. The July 30 deadline for a U.S. tariff determination on refined copper imports, following a Trump executive order directing a structural review, remains unresolved and adds a second vector of near-term uncertainty. None of these factors alter UBS's 2026 structural copper deficit estimate of 520,000 tonnes — the long-run supply shortfall driven by 199,000 tonnes of major miner guidance cuts is a multi-year condition — but geopolitical flare-ups reliably trigger junior copper equity liquidation before the fundamental re-rating. For TSXV copper porphyry explorers in Canada, Chile, or Argentina with no Iranian supply chain exposure, the pullback in a structurally tight market is a technical dislocation from fundamentals, not a change in them.

headline: ROXMORE RESOURCES DRILLS 247m @ 0.51 g/t Au AT CONVERSE NEVADA — INFILL UPGRADING INFERRED BLOCKS; 2ND RIG ARRIVING MID-JULY (TSX:RM)
source_name: The Prospector News / Roxmore Resources Inc.
snippet: Roxmore Resources Inc. (TSX: RM, OTCQX: GARLF) reported from its 30,000-metre Phase 1 infill campaign at the Converse Gold Project on Nevada's Battle Mountain-Eureka Trend: hole CV26-010C returned 247.2 metres grading 0.51 g/t gold and 3.79 g/t silver from 131.7 metres, including 34.3 metres at 1.25 g/t gold — intersecting blocks currently classified as inferred resource and confirming grades that exceeded the block model predictions for those zones, implying the inferred resource will partially convert to indicated upon remodelling. The critical context: this is a resource confidence exercise, not a discovery program. Upgrading inferred ounces to indicated is the foundational work required for a bankable feasibility study and is the technical prerequisite for development financing at current gold pricing. A second diamond drill rig arrives mid-July and a second RC rig in September, accelerating the program substantially through H2 2026. Converse's position on the Battle Mountain-Eureka Trend — the geological corridor hosting Barrick's Cortez Complex — establishes the neighbourhood's production credentials; 247-metre bulk-grade intercepts at 0.51 g/t in that district, consistently exceeding block model predictions, builds the case that the existing inferred resource is conservatively modelled relative to what the drill data will support.

headline: ALKANE RESOURCES HITS BJÖRKDAL'S DEEPEST GOLD AT 762m DEPTH IN SWEDEN — EASTERN EXTENSION GROWING, MINE-LIFE RUNWAY BUILDING (ASX:ALK)
snippet: Alkane Resources Limited (ASX: ALK, TSX: ALK) reported July 8 that 29 drill holes targeting the eastern and northern extensions of the Björkdal Gold Mine in Sweden have extended known gold mineralisation to a record depth of 762 metres below surface — the deepest confirmed gold intersection in the mine's operating history — with high-grade intervals that confirm vein geometry and grade continuity at depth. Björkdal processes 1.4 million tonnes per year from underground workings and carries Ore Reserves of 13.05 Mt at 1.29 g/t gold; the eastern extension program is the mine-life growth mechanism, not a greenfield exploration bet. Alkane's Swedish asset provides jurisdiction diversification away from Australia — Björkdal operates under Sweden's stable mining code in an EU member state, insulated from Australian state-level royalty and permitting variables. The 762-metre depth extension is practically significant: as Björkdal's current production zones advance toward depletion in the medium term, the eastern extension provides the mineralised envelope for a deeper decline — turning what would otherwise be a fixed-life asset into a potentially multi-decade operation if the depth trend sustains through infill drilling. At $4,100+ gold, that mine-life optionality is worth pricing.
